probeMissions: NET FIRST, as the revised brief requires. mutation-testcmd.sh on the pristine build: exit 0, 709/709, 32.8 s. Then under each of the six mutants: all six exit 0, 709 pass, identical test COUNT across all seven runs, which is how the agent knows no file was silently dropped under load. Plus the four non-unit nets pristine and per mutant, 28 runs, all exit 0. So unlike the onDiskSpelling story, NONE of these six is killed on macOS. Load was 14-19 during the runs, which biases toward spurious FAILURES, i.e. toward wrongly clearing a mutant, and nothing failed, so the bias did not operate.

m-fold: the example mission with code/src/core/domain/ϴguard.ts on disk (U+03F4 GREEK CAPITAL THETA SYMBOL) cited as ϑguard.ts (U+03D1 GREEK THETA SYMBOL). Both names created from Node, never through shell argv, so no Unicode round-trip. Verified on the volume first: reading ϑguard.ts opens the on-disk ϴguard.ts, so the pointer resolves here and would not on a case-sensitive runner. Pristine: exit 1, gaps, conformance 1. One mission exercising all three functions at once.

m-fold-theta, the control that proves m-fold is not an accident: same on-disk U+03F4 name, pointer written with U+03B8 (ordinary theta). Under the caseFold mutant it STILL refuses, byte-identical, because plain toLowerCase() collapses U+03F4 onto U+03B8 and the realpath rung re-derives the verdict. It is the U+03D1 spelling that gets past both rungs. Choosing the wrong control here is precisely how one concludes harmless for a live false green.

m-tom: a fenced block whose CLOSING fence sits on the line immediately above the Rule conformance heading, with no blank line between them (ordinary markdown, GFM renders it identically), plus prose inside the section, and a self-citation. Pristine: exit 1, gaps, conformance 1.

m-outside: a repository root containing proj/ and shared/ϴguard.ts, the row citing ../shared/ϑguard.ts. resolvePointer admits it through the repoRootAbove branch, the spelling diverges, and the remedy cannot be expressed relative to the project, so the no-remedy message renders. Pristine: exit 1, conformance 1.

m-dotdot: what the remedy the '..' mutants would prescribe actually does. Pristine: exit 1, 'resolves to <parent> — outside the project this mission audits (ADR-0019)'. The RWD-2026-0034 dead end verbatim.

DIRECT BATTERY, 20 cases through the module's own exports, one JSON line per case, diffed pristine against each mutant. Every state under test asserted to EXIST before anything is asserted about it: the symlinked-root shape checks lstat().isSymbolicLink(), that realpath resolves to the real directory, that the WRITTEN root does not contain the canonical spelling, and that the CANONICAL root does. Sensitivity controls that must NOT move and do not: sentinels to null, root-itself to null, '../x.ts' to null, '../..' to null, GUARD.TS to code/guard.ts, sigma to code/ςx.ts, ss to code/ßy.ts, exact spelling to SPELLING_VERIFIED. Battery run 7 times.
self-gate: baseline exit 0, 4519 bytes. Both lists probed, 0 of 5 and 0 of 2 observable.
base: init --yes --example, untouched, green. Present so a mutant that turns anything green-to-red or red-to-green is visible.

m1 'case divergence inside the project': a pointer rewritten to Guard.TS while the file is guard.ts. No repository marker sits anywhere above the mission, verified by walking every ancestor for the five markers, so the SECOND root is null — this mission drives the falsy-root arm at the gate. Pristine exit 1, naming the on-disk spelling.

m2 'the workspace allowance, remedy must climb': a .git marker, a shared/guard.ts sibling, the project inside it, the pointer citing ../shared/Guard.TS. Resolves outside the project root but inside repoRootAbove, mis-spelled, so the remedy must be expressed against the project root AND climb. Pristine exit 1, naming ../shared/guard.ts.

m3 'the fold rung, end to end': a real sguard.ts added and the pointer rewritten to cite it with U+017F, written from JS so no round-trip through argv. Only caseFold can match that name. Pristine exit 1. Sensitivity proven: replacing caseFold with a plain toLowerCase turns this mission exit 1 to exit 0, a false green.

DIRECT-DRIVE BATTERY, 196 cases. Every root and every spelling is a directory or file that REALLY EXISTS under a mkdtemp root canonicalised with realpathSync.native, and the temp root is redacted so two runs are byte-comparable. P01-P15: the two questions the function answers, the identity and climb-out guards, the falsy-root arm, a symlinked root reproducing the Windows 8.3 shape. S01-S12: the structural guard. X001-X143: the 13 all-falsy root tuples crossed with 11 spellings — the COMPLETE domain in which the accepted list is empty. Y001-Y012: the empty spelling against 12 root shapes including the real cwd and the real repo root. F01-F12 and F90/F91: the fold over real APFS files.

WHOLE UNIT NET per mutant, read by exit code and by the reporter's fail counter, never by grepping a mark — the pristine output already contains a failure mark inside a CLI error message a test asserts on. Pristine exit 0, 723 tests, fail 0. Plus the four nets npm test runs besides the unit suite, invoked directly against the mutated dist because npm test rebuilds first and the rebuild erases the mutant.

REACHABILITY INSTRUMENTATION, three modes patched into dist and run over the whole corpus (723 unit tests, the four missions, the battery): one records every evaluation of the else arm, one records every argument isSpelling receives, one records the truthiness of the roots tuple each caller passes. Each restores the pristine build and re-checks its sha256.

verdicts.evidence: The empty spelling cannot pass either call site. At the exported parameter, the very next test rejects it for EVERY root: identity cannot hold because falsy roots are filtered out one line above, and the prefix test cannot hold for any non-empty root. Measured, not reasoned: 12 root shapes built from REAL directories — the process cwd, the repo root, the project root, a nested root, the filesystem root, dot, dot-dot, and four multi-root calls — all null on both builds. At the gate's call site, the argument domain was instrumented over the whole corpus: 4109 observations, 39 distinct values, and every one of the six empty-string observations came from the exported parameter, never from the gate, because the resolver only ever yields null, a sentinel, or a non-empty path. SENSITIVITY CONTROL in the same function and the same return statement: defeating the OTHER conjunct moved 3 of 196 battery cases and killed the unit test that names it. So the battery reaches this function and is sensitive to it; only the empty-string conjunct is inert.
verdicts.mission: reachability mode 'isspelling-domain'; battery Y001-Y012 and S01-S12

verdicts.evidence: Two observable flips. (a) Case B6, as above: the empty spelling is no longer excluded, null becomes 'src'. (b) Case B7, unique to this mutant: a legitimate spelling equal to the marker string is now REFUSED, so the gate drops from 'The file is spelled ...' to the no-remedy message for any file whose path is that string. The 18 remaining battery cases byte-identical; nets all exit 0; all missions identical. Not equivalent (two demonstrated behaviour changes), not display-only (the return is a machine value that also decides WHICH message is emitted), not defence-in-depth (no net moved).
verdicts.mission: direct battery B6 and B7; all missions identical

verdicts.evidence: The fold's output is never rendered or returned; its single consumer compares two folded names, so only the PARTITION it induces can be observed. The two folds induce the same partition, measured three ways. (1) All 1,112,064 code points less surrogates: toUpperCase is idempotent on every one, 0 classes split in either direction — the relation is identical, not merely finer or coarser. (2) String level, because case mapping is context-sensitive (Final_Sigma): 322,605 distinct strings of length 1 to 5 drawn from the 2,968 case- and normalisation-interesting BMP characters, plus targeted sequences around sigma, the sharp s pair and the dotted i — 0 splits either way. (3) Through the COMPILED fold on real APFS files, which is what the doctrine asks for: the anchor of every class the shipped fold merges written to disk and each other member asked of onDiskSpelling, about 200 classes and 1000 pairs over an adversarial alphabet — every pair still merged. SENSITIVITY CONTROL on this exact expression: replacing it with a plain toLowerCase killed 9 unit tests, moved the battery, and turned mission m3 from exit 1 to exit 0, a false green. So m3 and the battery do move for a change to this fold; they do not move for this one.
verdicts.mission: m3, battery F01-F12 and F91, the two Unicode sweeps
